abilities.name: Ride to Glory
abilities.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly IRON MARCH INFANTRY HERO and up to 1 friendly non-HERO IRON MARCH INFANTRY unit that have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit's passengers. They have now been deployed.

warscrolls.name: Toll's Companions
warscrolls.base_size: Valius, the Keeper Aqshian: 40mm, Mistress Verentia, Balthas the gryph-hound and Lyssa Revenya: 28.5mm
warscrolls.notes: This unit can only be taken in Callis and Toll’s regiment.

abilities.name: Hidden Agents
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and a friendly Callis and Toll unit if those units have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve in the shadows. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Emerge from the Shadows
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is in the shadows.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from the enemy mark and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up the Callis and Toll unit in the shadows wholly within 6" of this unit, more than 6" from the enemy mark and more than 9" from all other enemy units.

abilities.name: Saviours of Cinderfall
abilities.effect: While a friendly Callis and Toll unit is wholly within this unit's combat range, both this unit and that friendly unit have WARD (5+).

warscrolls.name: Warden King
warscrolls.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

abilities.name: Fearless Leader
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: Ancestral Grudgebearer
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in your opponent's army to bear a grudge against. You can pick an enemy unit that is in reserve.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN units that target that unit.

warscrolls.name: War Hydra
warscrolls.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

abilities.name: Impossible To Destroy
abilities.effect: Heal (6) this unit.

abilities.name: Six-headed Strike
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscrolls.name: Wildercorps Hunters
warscrolls.base_size: Wildercorps Warden, Arbalest: 40mm, 2 x Leatherhides and Trailblazer: 28.5mm, 2 x Scouts and 4 x Trailhounds: 25mm
warscrolls.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

abilities.name: Expert Pathfinders
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to two friendly non-MONSTER non-WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE units if none of them have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve scouting ahead. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Prepared Arrival
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is scouting ahead.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each other friendly unit scouting ahead wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscrolls.composition: The champion is a Wildercorps Warden and is armed with a Hunting Crossbow, Wildercorps Hunting Weapons and a Trailhound’s Ferocious Bite. 6/11 models in this unit are Wildercorpsmen and are armed with a Hunting Crossbow and Wildercorps Hunting Weapons. 4/11 models are Trailhounds and are armed with a Trailhound’s Ferocious Bite.

abilities.name: Spiritual Locus
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Jacobus Vyne uses a SPELL or SHOOT ability, you can measure range and visibility from this MANIFESTATION instead of from that friendly unit.
